name: Common crop origin
path: Two fruit vendors → same growing region → same drought/freeze
verify: Tier-2 origin by crop, season and lot; supplier names are not evidence of diversification.

name: Packaging feedstock
path: Two converters → same resin/mill → shared capacity constraint
verify: Resin producer, resin grade, backup tooling, converter and mill allocation.

name: Transport chokepoint
path: Two import origins → common port/canal/carrier → correlated delays
verify: Actual port pairs, service strings, transshipment, inland rail corridor.

name: Regional operating footprint
path: Central Illinois facilities → overlapping weather/labor region
verify: Facility overlap is public; utilities, labor pools and incident impact correlation require validation.

name: Digital and equipment dependency
path: Production / ERP / recovery → common identity or vendor service
verify: Authorized internal inventory and recovery tests. No public identification of installed systems is assumed.

name: Shared public recruiting provider
path: Two company-linked application portals → same Paycom public recruiting domain → potential common application-access dependency
basis: Company HTML confirms two public links to paycomonline.net; distinct internal systems and provider infrastructure are not established.
verify: Verify recruiting continuity with authorized HR/IT. Do not infer payroll, HRIS, identity or ERP use. Provider-level correlation and effective redundancy remain unmeasured.

name: Potential shared Central Illinois highway corridor
path: Congerville and Deer Creek regional road context → potential I-74 routing overlap → correlated transport disruption if routes are shared
verify: Check actual origin/destination lanes and carrier routing. Nearby mapped highways do not prove use or redundancy; no quantified company correlation is assigned.
